2.text: ForeverYours is a voice companion for Dad, briefed by his family. When his safety is at stake, it raises a flag for his daughter, and tells him first, out loud. Everything else he says stays between them.

3.text: His daughter briefs it once, from work. One line: a check-up with Dr. Tan on Thursday. Nothing to set up on Dad's side.
